verdict.rationale: BILL documents an audit-trail endpoint (`/v3/reports/audit-trail/vendor/{vendorId}`), custom approval policies, and record export, and markets S&E transactions as 'automatically compliant'. However, the documented audit trail covers vendor objects (AP side), and nothing shows a per-expense history of edits, approvals and policy checks. Missing for 10: an expense/transaction-level audit trail, a logged history of approvals and policy-check results per expense, audit-ready export of S&E expense records, and independent corroboration that it holds up in an external audit.
